## Changes / 改动说明

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. English or Chinese is welcome.
请说明解决的用户问题和主要改动，欢迎中文或英文。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] No secrets, real documents, logs, databases or personal paths / 未提交秘密、真实文档、日志、数据库或个人完整路径
- [ ] English and Chinese docs/help updated for behavior changes / 已同步中英文文档或帮助页
- [ ] Interface changes checked in both languages / 界面改动已验证中英文

## Screenshots (for interface changes) / 界面截图

Include only redacted screenshots. / 请只附脱敏截图。
